data.description: 获取comm_max_stream参数推荐值。current_value为DN实际comm_max_stream值。recommended_value为根据当前环境规格计算出的DNcomm_max_stream参数的最大推荐值，取小于通过公式计算出的具体值calculated_value的1024的整数倍。

data.cmd_content: select * from dbe_perf.summary_statement where unique_sql_id={unique_sql_id} limit 100;

data.description: 单表(表和索引)占用的磁盘空间
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: select pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size('"{schema_name}"."{table_name}"')) limit 100;

data.description: 查询表、索引等的创建或最后修改时间
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: select c.oid,u.usename,n.nspname,c.relname,o.ctime,o.mtime from pg_class c left join pg_object o on c.oid = o.object_oid left join pg_namespace n on c.relnamespace = n.oid left join pg_user u on u.usesysid = c.relowner where n.nspname ={schema_name} and c.relname={relname} limit 100;

data.description: 查询表结构字段信息
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: select pn.nspname, pg_get_userbyid(pc.relowner) tableowner, pc.relname as tablename, pa.attname, pa.attnum, format_type(pa.atttypid, pa.atttypmod) type, pg_catalog.col_description(pa.attrelid, pa.attnum) description from pg_class pc, pg_namespace pn, pg_attribute pa where pn.oid = pc.relnamespace and pa.attrelid = pc.oid and attnum>0 and pn.nspname = '{schema_name}' and pc.relname='{table_name}';

data.description: 查看表上锁
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: select a.pid,a.sessionid,substring(a.query,0,1000),l.locktype,l.mode from pg_stat_activity a,pg_locks l where a.pid=l.pid and a.sessionid=l.sessionid and l.relation=(select c.oid from pg_class c left join pg_namespace n on c.relnamespace = n.oid where n.nspname = {schema_name} and relname= {relname}) limit 100;

data.description: 查看表上锁
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: select a.pid,a.sessionid,substring(a.query,0,1000),l.locktype,l.mode from pg_stat_activity a,pg_locks l where a.pid=l.pid and a.sessionid=l.sessionid and l.relation=(select c.oid from pg_class c left join pg_namespace n on c.relnamespace = n.oid where n.nspname = {schema_name} and relname= {relname}) limit 100;

data.description: 获取库中表大小（包含索引和toast）
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: SELECT schemaname,relname, pg_total_relation_size(concat(schemaname,'.',relname))/1024/1024/1024 table_size_GB FROM PG_STAT_USER_TABLES ORDER BY 3 DESC limit 50;

data.description: 获取库中不包含索引所有表大小
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: SELECT schemaname,relname, pg_table_size(concat(schemaname,'.',relname))/1024/1024/1024 table_size_GB FROM PG_STAT_USER_TABLES ORDER BY 3 DESC limit 50;

data.description: 查看指定表统计信息
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: select schemaname, relname, n_live_tup, n_dead_tup, (n_dead_tup/(n_live_tup+1)) as dead_rating from pg_stat_user_tables where schemaname = {schema_name} and relname = {relname} order by dead_rating desc limit 100;

data.description: 获取表结构
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: select pg_get_tabledef('"{schema_name}"."{table_name}"');

data.description: 查看数据库进程所有线程内存上下文占用大小
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: select contextname, sum(totalsize)/1024/1024 totalsize, sum(freesize)/1024/1024 freesize, count(1) sum from pv_thread_memory_context group by contextname order by sum desc limit 10;

data.description: 查看数据库进程所有线程内存上下文占用大小
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: select contextname, sum(totalsize)/1024/1024 totalsize, sum(freesize)/1024/1024 freesize, count(1) sum from gs_thread_memory_context group by contextname order by sum desc limit 10;

data.description: 查看线程池
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: SELECT node_name,worker_info FROM dbe_perf.global_threadpool_status limit 100;

data.description: 查看具体session占用
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: select sessid, sum(totalsize)/1024/1024 as totalsize, count(1) as count from pv_session_memory_context group by sessid order by 2 desc limit 10;

data.description: 查看具体session占用
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: select sessid, sum(totalsize)/1024/1024 as totalsize, count(1) as count from gs_session_memory_context group by sessid order by 2 desc limit 10;

data.description: 查看用户锁信息
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: select a.usesysid,a.usename,b.failcount,b.locktime,b.rolstatus,b.passwordexpired from pg_user a, pg_user_status b where a.usesysid=b.roloid limit 100;

data.description: 查看等待事件
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: select wait_status,wait_event,count(1) from pgxc_thread_wait_status group by 1,2 order by 3 desc limit 20;

data.description: 查看等待事件
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: select wait_status,wait_event,count(1) from pg_thread_wait_status group by 1,2 order by 3 desc limit 20;

data.description: SQL查找-query进行过滤(按照执行时间: now()-query_start逆序排列)
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: select pid,sessionid,unique_sql_id,state,usename,client_addr,now()-query_start as elp,substring(query,0,1000) from pgxc_stat_activity where usename !='rdsAdmin' and state != 'idle' and instr(query, {query}) order by elp desc limit 30;

data.description: SQL查找-query进行过滤(按照执行时间: now()-query_start逆序排列)
data.creator: admin
data.cmd_content: select pid,sessionid,unique_sql_id,state,usename,client_addr,now()-query_start as elp,substring(query,0,1000) from pg_stat_activity where usename !='rdsAdmin' and state != 'idle' and instr(query, {query}) order by elp desc limit 30;
